model_temperature_desc: Parameters that control the randomness and creativity of the language model output. Low temperature settings for more predictable output; Temperature settings are higher and outputs are more varied and less predictable.
model_top_p_desc: Control the diversity and quality of the generated text.
model_max_tokens_desc: Used to control the length and quality of chat replies. In general, a larger max_tokens value can generate longer and more complete replies, but may also increase the risk of generating irrelevant or duplicate content. Smaller values of max_tokens can produce shorter and more concise replies, but can also result in incomplete or incoherent content. Therefore, you need to select a proper value for max_tokens based on different scenarios and requirements.
model_frequency_penalty_desc: This parameter is used to adjust the mode in which the model processes frequently used tokens. That is, if a token appears frequently in the training set, the model will be punished when generating the token. When the value of frequency_penalty is positive, the model tends to generate tokens with low occurrence frequency, that is, the model tends to use unusual words.
model_presence_penalty_desc: Control the repetition of topics in a conversation.  Set the parameter to a positive value to avoid unified topics in model output. If the parameter is set to a negative value, the model output is closely related to the same topic.
name: Name
llm_desc: Large model nodes allow you to configure deployed models within the nodes, aiming to utilize large model capabilities in application orchestration.
